protocol_consistency.vault_protocol: https across all prod configs (vault.hcl lines 14-18, 46-47; docker-compose.prod.yaml lines 59-61; api env line 103)
protocol_consistency.nginx_upstreams: http (nginx.conf lines 83-87, 89-93 - both api_backend and frontend_backend use http://)
protocol_consistency.client_tls_verify: vault uses -tls-skip-verify in healthcheck (docker-compose.prod.yaml line 73); api VAULT_ADDR is https but no client cert config visible; nginx does not proxy to vault

unnecessary_exposures: 5432:5432 - postgres exposed to host (should be internal only; only api needs access)
6379:6379 - redis exposed to host (should be internal only; only api needs access)
8200:8200 - vault API exposed to host (consider restricting to internal or VPN)
8201:8201 - vault cluster exposed to host (internal only)
9090:9090 - api metrics exposed to host (duplicate with prometheus scrape via nginx /metrics)
3000:3000 - api exposed directly to host (nginx should be sole entry point)
9091:9090 - prometheus exposed to host (should be internal; grafana/alertmanager scrape internally)
3001:3000 - grafana exposed to host (should be behind nginx or VPN)

volume_permissions_issues: secrets/ directory files are 644 (should be 600 for production)
config/nginx-tls/ empty - nginx will fail to start without TLS certificates
Docker volumes created by containers run as root; no explicit UID/GID mapping for non-root containers

secret_file_requirements: All 8 docker secrets must exist as files before docker-compose up
Placeholder values in elevenlabs_key.txt, veo_key.txt, runway_key.txt, luma_key.txt must be replaced
nginx TLS certificates required at ./config/nginx-tls/fullchain.pem and ./config/nginx-tls/privkey.pem (currently missing)

runtime_contradictions.issue: Vault port 8200 exposed on host; vault container fails to start with 'address already in use' (observed in logs). Likely conflict with host process or duplicate binding.
nginx.conf references /etc/nginx/tls/fullchain.pem and /etc/nginx/tls/privkey.pem but config/nginx-tls/ directory is empty. Nginx will fail to start.
nginx depends_on frontend but frontend has no healthcheck. Nginx may start before frontend is ready.
api depends_on vault with condition: service_healthy, but vault healthcheck uses 'vault status -tls-skip-verify' which requires vault to be unsealed. Vault starts sealed in production.
api uses VAULT_ADDR=https://vault:8200 but no VAULT_CACERT or client cert configuration. Node.js client may reject self-signed cert unless NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS is set.
redis command uses --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD} but redis healthcheck uses -a ${REDIS_PASSWORD}. If password contains special chars, shell escaping may differ.
api exposes ports 3000 and 9090 on host despite nginx being the ingress. Creates attack surface and port conflicts with dev stack.
dev and prod both bind 5432, 6379, 8200, 3000, 9090, 9091, 3001 on host. Cannot run simultaneously.
Vault TLS listener requires client CA (tls_client_ca_file). API and other clients must present client certs, but no client certs are generated or distributed.
Validation accepts 'healthy' OR 'none' as passing. Services without healthchecks (frontend, nginx) false-pass.
Docker secrets defined but .env.example references *_FILE variants. Compose does not automatically map docker secrets to env vars; application must read /run/secrets/ directly.

dev_prod_drift: port conflicts: both stacks bind 5432, 6379, 8200, 3000, 9090, 9091, 3001 on host
volume conflicts: both use postgres_data, redis_data, prometheus_data, grafana_data volume names (different project prefixes: fte_ vs tmp_)
network conflicts: both create fte-network (different project labels: com.docker.compose.project=fte vs tmp)
protocol differences: dev uses VAULT_ADDR=http://vault:8200; prod uses https://vault:8200
vault mode: dev uses VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID (unsealed dev mode); prod uses raft storage with TLS (sealed, needs init/unseal)
redis: dev no password; prod requires password
api: dev uses Dockerfile.dev with volume mounts; prod uses Dockerfile.prod
frontend: dev exposes 5173; prod behind nginx only
grafana: dev uses env password; prod uses docker secret file
prometheus: dev uses config/prometheus.yml; prod uses config/prometheus.prod.yml
safe_startup_sequence: 2. Generate nginx TLS certificates (Let's Encrypt or self-signed) in ./config/nginx-tls/
4. Start vault (depends on postgres_data volume for raft storage, but can start independently)
5. Initialize and unseal vault (manual or scripted)
7. Start api (depends on postgres, redis, vault healthy+unsealed)
8. Start frontend (no hard deps, but api should be ready)
11. Start nginx (depends on api and frontend)
Critical: vault must be unsealed before api healthcheck passes. Add vault unseal step to deployment automation.
